gloss: drawing a figure; geometric construction; drafting

definitions.gloss: drawing a figure; geometric construction; drafting (a diagram or plan)
definitions.explanation: The act of producing a geometric figure, diagram, technical drawing, or plan — typically following a set of rules or requirements. Most often encountered in (a) school mathematics, where it refers to classical ruler-and-compass constructions, and (b) engineering/architecture, where it refers to producing technical drawings. Used as a verbal noun with する: {作図|さくず}する ('to draw a figure; to draft').

examples.japanese: {作図|さくず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧。
⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{正三角形|せいさんかっけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{作図|さくず}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To construct an equilateral triangle with only a compass and straightedge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{設計|せっけい}{図|ず}→設計図：14805_sekkeizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作図|さくず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧CAD⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: CAD software is used to draft design drawings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{垂直|すいちょく}→垂直：05446_suichoku⟧{二等分線|にとうぶんせん}や{角|かく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二等分線|にとうぶんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作図|さくず}⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: In junior high school mathematics, students learn how to construct perpendicular bisectors and angle bisectors.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ ('make; create') and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ ('figure; diagram'). Literally 'making a figure'. Used both as a noun ({作図|さくず}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ 'construction problem') and as a verbal noun with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

USAGE:
- School math sense: classical geometric constructions using only a straightedge and compass (⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧). Typical Japanese middle-school curriculum topics.
- Engineering / drafting sense: producing technical drawings, often now on a computer with CAD. {作図|さくず}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧ ('drafting software') is a common phrase.
- Does not refer to drawing pictures or art; for that use ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧ or {描画|びょうが}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作図|さくず}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to draw a figure; to draft
- {作図|さくず}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: construction problem (in math)
- {作図|さくず}⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: method of construction
- {作図|さくず}⟦ツール→ツール：11044_tsuuru⟧: drawing/drafting tool
- {作図|さくず}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧: drafting/CAD software
- ⟦{設計|せっけい}{図|ず}→設計図：14805_sekkeizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作図|さくず}: drafting of design drawings
- ⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{作図|さくず}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to construct with compass and straightedge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製図|せいず}: drafting; technical drawing — near-synonym emphasizing professional/engineering drawings. {作図|さくず} is broader and more common in math contexts.
- {描画|びょうが}: drawing (a picture) — artistic/graphical rendering.
- ⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧: design — the full process of design, of which drafting is one part.
- ⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧: creation; preparation — generic 'making' of documents; less specific than {作図|さくず}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{図形|ずけい}→図形：04036_zukei⟧: geometric figure
- ⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧: straightedge; ruler
- ⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧: (geometric) compass
- ⟦{垂直|すいちょく}→垂直：05446_suichoku⟧{二等分線|にとうぶんせん}: perpendicular bisector
- CAD: computer-aided design
